info.description: This documentation is provided to define every object model used in the main flows of the B2B API.In the first step, get APIKey from SnappTrip support team. set api-key in header of every requests.
info.title: SnappTrip B2B API v2

post.description:
Search for hotels in a city. The city ID is required to search for hotels in a city. Return minimum price for each hotel.
The city ID can be obtained from the city API.
Accommodation Type can be one of the following "", "Hotel", "Pansion", "Apartments", "Guesthouse", "Motel", "Inn", "Traditionalhouse"

get.description:
Request for Hotels availability. It would check for 1 adult for 1 room reservation in the selected hotel ID. Send checkin and checkout (YYYY-MM-DD) in AD data. AD stands for Anno Domini, which is Latin for in the year of the Lord. It's a way of counting years based on the estimated birth of Jesus Christ.
Multiple IDs Allowed (Example: id=1,2,3,4) (50 Max).
All prices have been provided in the Toman currency. The price field is the final price (=minus the discount price).

parameters.description: Hotel ID (multiple IDs can be passed)
parameters.name: id

400.description: hotel ids cannot be empty, max length of hotel ids is 50, date cannot be before today

post.description: First step of creating booking. This endpoint will create a booking and return a reservation code. Before of this step, it is mandatory to select hotel ID and room ID. The reservation code will be used in the next steps. checkin and checkout are date with this format time 2001-01-12.Note is a comment of customer for special requests  for extra requests such as wheelchair and etx. Phone number should be valid Iranian mobile format (e.g. +98912..., 0912...). In each request room_id should be same (it is not possible to book different rooms id in one request). If the room has a rack, selecting a date range between begin and end is mandatory. Please set the foreigner field to false for Iranian nationals and true for all others, as incorrect information may result in penalties for the guest. For free transfer or corporate arrangements, please include your flight number, arrival time, and number of transfers required in the note field.

400.description: input time format is not valid, room should have at least one guest, guest name cannot be empty, room should have at least one value, date cannot be before today, phone number should start with +98, phone cannot be empty

post.description:
After Initial Booking, It is mandatory to confirm the booking. If you didn't lock the booking, It will automatically lock and confirm the booking.
Don't using this endpoint for testing purposes. If you want to test the booking using the hotel_id 2766 and room_id 18607.

This action is only accept on special clients. PLease check your contract with snapptrip before use it. After create Book and before confirm Book, you can lock the Book.Lock will hold the room for 15 minutes. You can directly call Confirm and skip this step.
